# wechat-local

> Agent Skill and local MCP / CLI for reading WeChat chat history on Windows: conversation search, message statistics, chat images, voice transcription, video frames, document reading, cached Moments, and Obsidian export.

The skill directory is named `wechat-local`. Start with SKILL.md to choose an operation. The Windows installer reuses existing programs, prepares the backend, and writes a STDIO MCP configuration. The published package exposes 16 tools; the tool reference lists their arguments. Data comes from the current account's records saved on the computer.

## Get started

- [Skill entry point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YZCore/wechat-local-skill/main/SKILL.md): Task matching and the workflow an agent follows.
- [Windows setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YZCore/wechat-local-skill/main/references/setup.md): Environment discovery, installation, local indexing, speech model, and MCP configuration.
- [Tool reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YZCore/wechat-local-skill/main/references/tools.md): All 16 MCP / CLI tools, parameters, and returned content.
- [Daily usage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YZCore/wechat-local-skill/main/references/usage.md): Search, media reading, statistics, CLI examples, and output locations.

## Project overview

- [中文介绍](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YZCore/wechat-local-skill/main/README.md): Capabilities, quick start, common questions, and project structure.
- [English overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YZCore/wechat-local-skill/main/README.en.md): Capabilities, installation, and agent integration in English.
- [Skill ZIP](https://github.com/YZCore/wechat-local-skill/raw/refs/heads/main/dist/wechat-local-skill.zip): Ready-to-install `wechat-local` directory, scripts, backend source, and documentation.
